summary.title: Profile
summary.content:
Engineering leader with 19+ years of experience across SaaS, startups, and founder-led environments. Scaled teams and backend/platform systems at Riverside, including leading a 27-person engineering group across 4 teams.

My career spans the full entrepreneurial lifecycle, from running a digital agency and co-founding a startup to helping Riverside grow from a 20-person startup into a 300+ person company. Most recently, I focused on hands-on AI product and workflow development during a career sabbatical.

items.description:
• Developed Verba, a privacy-first macOS dictation app combining on-device transcription with local LLMs.

  • Created a document-intelligence workflow for Informia, using vision models and evidence scoring.

  • Combined grounded search and cited answers in FallosES, a legal research assistant.

  • Advised a stealth startup founder on product scope, technical architecture, and roadmap in a fractional CTO-style engagement, including an initial product skeleton and proof of concept.

roles.position: Senior Engineering Manager (Internal Title: Group Lead)
roles.description:
• Led 27 engineers and managers across Platform, Publishing, Business, and Growth, working through team leads and engineering managers, with QA leadership spanning the group.

  • Owned budget and compensation planning and partnered with the CEO on evaluating and hiring VP-level engineering leaders. Conducted 100+ interviews and provided final technical sign-off for senior backend and system-design candidates across the organization.

  • Coached team leads and engineering managers, delegated outcomes, and clarified decision ownership so teams could deliver without depending on constant intervention.

  • Worked with Product and Design on scope, acceptance criteria, and quarterly planning across teams, reducing late rework and improving delivery predictability.

  • Guided backend evolution from a monolith toward Kafka and Protobuf services. Led design review and coordination across two teams to ship an event-driven token ledger for AI feature consumption.

  • Helped establish the dedicated platform team and shared service standards, working with the VP of Engineering and team leads on service templates, API contracts, and simpler release workflows.

  • Led engineering work across recurring SOC 2 Type 2 audit cycles, working directly with auditors and coordinating remediation and repeatable team processes that supported enterprise contracts.

  • Piloted GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and AI-assisted code review across teams, addressing privacy and approval concerns and bringing the tools into everyday engineering workflows.

items.name: Verba
items.description: Built a local-first speech-to-text app for macOS, including the product flow, licensing model, and on-device transcription pipeline. Combined transcription with local language-model cleanup so users can dictate without sending audio to the cloud.

items.name: Informia
items.description: Built an AI-assisted workflow for property registry processes in Argentina, covering document extraction, review, and browser-assisted submission. Extracts key fields from scanned deeds, shows supporting evidence, and uses context caching to reduce operating cost.

items.name: FallosES
items.description: Built a legal research assistant for Spain with a WhatsApp interface, lightweight web app, and grounded search over official sources. Maintains context and returns cited answers with concise summaries.

roles.description:
• Built Riverside's first formal full-stack team by consolidating engineers from a flat structure and hiring 2 additional engineers, growing the team to 6.

  • Coached 3 high-performing engineers into Team Lead roles as the Dashboard group evolved into Riverside's core Platform team.

  • Oversaw core platform services and the user dashboard, including Stripe-backed billing, plans, entitlements, and account overrides that supported enterprise sales and pricing changes.

  • Split critical services from the monolith and introduced end-to-end observability across backend services and Kafka flows, contributing to a 33% reduction in overall system latency.

  • Led development of Show Notes and Magic Clips, Riverside's first two LLM-powered features, working closely with Product to iterate based on usage metrics, export activity, and in-app user feedback. Established shared context-handling and quota-management capabilities that other teams reused.

• Joined as one of the first 6 engineers and shipped across the studio, dashboard, clips, accounts, and early enterprise capabilities, using customer and support feedback to guide product decisions.

  • Took ownership of billing, plans, and entitlements, evolving the initial Stripe-and-webhooks setup into an internal monetization model. Resolved monolith and database bottlenecks and mentored junior engineers on architecture and design.

items.description:
• Co-founded and led a WebRTC video-production SaaS business from concept and team building to a product used by customers including Mediaset and Condé Nast.

  • Owned product strategy, technical direction, and go-to-market planning, with hands-on work across backend services, video processing, and mobile development.

  • Secured a place in the Startupbootcamp Media accelerator in the Netherlands and served as the primary spokesperson, pitching to audiences of 250+ investors.

• Co-founded and led a 6-person digital agency for 11 years, overseeing delivery, staffing, and client operations.

  • Delivered web, mobile, and interactive installations for agencies and enterprise clients across 5 countries, including financial services projects and physical-digital campaigns for malls, airports, and retail environments.
